turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first; start there.
I don't think this is productive.

Productive. My son found out about a zero from his phone, and you asked for this meeting, so either you explain who decided that and on what basis, or I walk down the hall to the principal's office right now.
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.

Go, then, and I'll be in the principal's office before your class starts. Procedure 4.2 says you call the parent before any mark goes in, and you didn't. That's the first thing I'll put on the principal's desk, Hale.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.

I won't be emailing, I'll be standing in that office in five minutes with your own procedure in my hand. I'm writing down that you said "I'm done here," Hale. The zero comes off, or this goes to the board.
